Finally, lifecycle phases finding’s code runs attached findings. file code context takes phases rule matched ; pattern inherits code context assigned step 3c. audit_package() returns pkgaudit object: named list file_contexts, code_contexts, patterns, errors data frames, plus metadata list recording scanned . three findings data frames carries one logical column per lifecycle phase. Failures contained rather fatal. Listing files, parsing script, evaluating XPath wrapped tryCatch(), unreadable file, malformed script, invalid XPath recorded row errors – giving stage, file, rule, message – scan continues next script rule.

R CMD INSTALL, R CMD build, and R CMD check all load the   package, so .onLoad() runs during those phases without any call from a user. at_autoconf: FALSE at_build: TRUE at_check: TRUE at_install_src: TRUE at_install_bin: FALSE at_load: TRUE at_attach: FALSE at_unload: FALSE at_detach: FALSE xpath: >-   (//expr | //expr_or_assign_or_help)[     (       (LEFT_ASSIGN or EQ_ASSIGN)       and expr[1]/SYMBOL[text() = '.onLoad']       and expr[FUNCTION]     )     or     (       RIGHT_ASSIGN       and expr[2]/SYMBOL[text() = '.onLoad']       and expr[1]//FUNCTION     )   ] xpath   <- rules$code_contexts$xpath[rules$code_contexts$name == "onLoad_base"] matches <- function(code) length(xml2::xml_find_all(as_xml(code), xpath)) > 0  matches(".onLoad <- function(libname, pkgname) NULL")    # assignment #> [1] TRUE matches(".onLoad = function(libname, pkgname) NULL")     # assignment with `=` #> [1] TRUE matches("(function(libname, pkgname) NULL) -> .onLoad")  # right assignment #> [1] TRUE matches(".onAttach <- function(libname, pkgname) NULL")  # a different hook #> [1] FALSE matches("message('.onLoad')")                            # only a mention #> [1] FALSE
